description: This file defines custom Cypress commands for mocking API interactions, UI login, and setting authentication tokens within a web application's test suite.

methods.name: mockApi
methods.description: Sets up network intercepts to mock API responses for login, user management, report management, and chart data.

methods.name: loginUI
methods.description: Automates the login process via the UI by filling in credentials and clicking the sign-in button.

methods.name: seedAuth
methods.description: Sets a fake authentication token directly in local storage to simulate an authenticated state.
